research.description: Finds and analyses market opportunities, competitors and demand.

market_research.description: analyse a market or niche from known information

web_research.description: search the internet, read public pages and report findings with cited sources

marketing.description: Positions products and brings customers, without paid ads unless permitted.

plan_campaign.description: plan an organic marketing campaign (text only)

create_campaign.description: build a ready-to-post campaign pack: dated posts per channel with images and videos, email sequence, blog article

development.description: Designs and writes software (as text; never executes it).

write_code.description: write code or technical specs as text

outline_content.description: outline a content piece or product

create_digital_product.description: build a finished digital product (printable planner, worksheet, tracker, journal, workbook or ebook): print-ready PDFs, previews, mockups, listing and download bundle

publish_content.description: publish content or list a product

design.description: Plans visual design, produces marketing images and videos.

design_brief.description: write a design brief or layout spec

create_graphics.description: produce marketing images: branded graphics, product images, AI photos

create_video.description: produce a short marketing video (Reels/TikTok/Shorts) with captions and voiceover
